comment: The two attenuverter-and-jack pairs are read only while the jack is patched; with nothing patched the trimmer has no effect at all. The panel prints FREQ, SWING, SHAPE and MIX over the four large knobs and RST over the reset jack; the four small trimmers carry no lettering. Panel lettering is drawn in code rather than in the SVG, so src/SwingLFO.cpp:275-330 is the authority on the names.
